description:
Officer Extension - The OP Fork

Adds the ability to increase level and elite skills cap of individual officer by spending storypoints.
Fork of the original OE here: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=23928
Cannot be used alongside the original OE since this is a fork, not a true addon.
And as you can see this is an complete ripoff of OE, even the forum formatting is a ripoff...

Again, please make sure you either REMOVE your original version of OE when using this, or use SMOL to manage the versions to prevent issues

Features:

Increase Officer Level Cap
Increase the level cap of an individual officer.
Costs the current maximum level of the officer in SP, unmodified this would be 5 for normal officers, and 6 for cyropod officers.
Disregards the officer's current level when increasing level cap as of now, so everyone starts at 5/6 even if their current level is 6+.
Can only be done when your officer is already at maximum level.

Increase Officer Elite Skills Cap
Increase the cap on elite skills of an individual officer.
Costs the current maximum elite skills of the officer in SP, unmodified this would be 1 for normal officers, and 4 for cyropod officers.
Disregards the officer's number of elite skills when increasing level cap as of now, so everyone starts at 1/4 even if they got more elite skills.
Can only be done when your officer is already at maximum level.

Known Issues:

Try To Avoid These
If you take the skill that increases officer max level AFTER you increases someone's max level to 14 or w/e level that learns all the skills, their actual max level will become 15 and the level-up button will forever haunt you. I can't fix it unless I actually manage to learn reflections, which is pretty much impossible..

superyuuki for pointing me to some crazy lib that supposedly can make a submod but I don't understand at all so I gave up.

and everone in discord who beared with my spamming of the modding channel.
Oh and PAGSM for been one of my prime motivators to make this mod. [And my own waifu mod that'll be updated when I get around it...]

Version History:

How It Came To Be
R.03:
- I promise I have tested the version files this time and it FINALLY WORKS!

R.02:
- Officers now have to be at max level before you can increase elite skills cap - mostly for cleaner UI.
- Fixed a crash due to incorrect version formats.

R.01:
- Added the button to increase officer elite skills cap, also at the expense of story points.
- Removed the arbitrary level cap as I devised a way to dynamically figure out if officers can still level up.

R.00:
- Initial release.
